meta.src:
schema: playbook/2
name: component_aZfEjVjF19X0oUF4E_playbook
title: Flow 1
actions:
  Define_Search_Parameters:
    title: Define Search Parameters
    type: transformation
    description: >
      Calculates current timestamp and oldest timestamp (7 days ago) for record filtering
    on-success:
    - Get_Rule_Record: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    transformations:
      now:
        title: Now
        description: ""
        display:
          functions:
          - function: dateParseBasic
            inputs:
            - Current Time
            - 
            - 
            - 
            - 
          advancedView: false
        inputs:
          expression: $dateParseBasic('Current Time',null,null,null,null)
          data: {}
        actionType: jsonata
        next: oldest_timestamp
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
      oldest_timestamp:
        title: Oldest Timestamp
        description: ""
        display:
          functions: []
          advancedView: true
        inputs:
          expression: $fromMillis($toMillis($now()) - 7 * 86400000)
          data: {}
        actionType: jsonata
        next: ""
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
    entrypoint: now
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
  Declare_Loop_Variables:
    title: Declare Loop Variables
    type: createVariables
    description: >
      Initializes pagination variables (page_number=0, more_pages=true) for iterating through records
    on-success:
    - While_There_Are_More_Records: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    inputs:
    - name: page_number
      value: 0
    - name: more_pages
      value: true
    inputSchemaReferenceId: 64500545-ff4f-4b1e-ad57-e50f2140e828
    outputSchemaReferenceId: efb74ae6-5a4c-4f13-bd2f-86c129f2fb0f
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
  While_There_Are_More_Records:
    title: While There Are More Records
    type: loop
    description: >
      Iterates through pages of CASE records while more pages exist
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    entrypoints:
    - Search_For_Pending_CASE_Records
    actions:
      Evaluate_And_Execute:
        title: Evaluate And Execute
        type: connector
        description: >
          Evaluates rule records against signal records and executes matching rules via sub-component
        on-success:
        - Has_Next_Page: {}
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        action: $playbook.component_aZLI4uETKIjW6g4Vz_playbook
        inputs:
          rule_records:
            $:ref: $actions.Get_Rule_Record.result.records
          signal_records:
            $:ref: $actions.Search_For_Pending_CASE_Records.result.records
        pool: $default
        testInputs: {}
        meta: {}
        delay: 0
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        asset: ""
        environment: {}
      Update_Loop_Variables:
        title: Update Loop Variables
        type: updateVariables
        description: >
          Updates pagination variables with new page number and more_pages flag for loop control
        on-success: []
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        inputs:
        - name: more_pages
          operation:
            type: set
            value: true
        - name: page_number
          operation:
            type: set
            value:
              $:ref: $actions.Increment_Page_Number.result.updated_page_number
        meta: {}
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        inputSchemaReferenceId: 9d5dd2d6-707c-464c-b30d-e3058d1c8788
        outputSchemaReferenceId: 49b7f403-7d35-4886-bdae-b4757b8148b1
      Increment_Page_Number:
        title: Increment Page Number
        type: transformation
        description: >
          Increments page number by 1 for next iteration of record search
        on-success:
        - Update_Loop_Variables: {}
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        transformations:
          updated_page_number:
            title: updated page number
            description: ""
            display:
              functions: []
              advancedView: true
            inputs:
              expression: actions.Search_For_Pending_Signal_Records.result.pageNumber + 1
              data:
                actions:
                  Search_For_Pending_Signal_Records:
                    result:
                      pageNumber:
                        $:ref: $actions.Search_For_Pending_CASE_Records.result.pageNumber
            actionType: jsonata
            next: ""
            timeout: 0
            meta: {}
        entrypoint: updated_page_number
        meta: {}
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
      Search_For_Pending_CASE_Records:
        meta: {}
        title: Search For Pending CASE Records
        type: recordAction
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        on-success:
        - Evaluate_And_Execute: {}
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        description: >
          Searches for pending CASE records with status filter and timestamp range, paginated by page_number
        inputs:
          applicationName: ""
          applicationId: aGLUPEw5Z3dKNx0wk
          filters:
          - fieldId: anvjb
            filterType: equals
            value: 6925d81be178578f94f5a73a
          - fieldId: ayizq
            filterType: greaterThanOrEqual
            value:
              $:ref: $actions.Define_Search_Parameters.result.oldest_timestamp
          filterType: AND
          returnFields: []
          limit: 500
          pageNumber:
            $:ref: $variables.page_number
        recordActionType: search
      Has_Next_Page:
        meta: {}
        title: Has Next Page
        type: conditional
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        on-success: []
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        description: ""
        conditions:
        - action: Increment_Page_Number
          condition:
            $:and:
            - - $:ref: $actions.Search_For_Pending_CASE_Records.result.hasNextPage
              - $:eq: true
        else: Update_Loop_Variables_a7ujy
        inputSchemaReferenceId: 8e29c3cb-cac9-4ec6-b71f-2e432be0304a
      Update_Loop_Variables_a7ujy:
        meta: {}
        title: Update Loop Variables
        type: updateVariables
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        on-success: []
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        description: >
          Updates pagination variables with new page number and more_pages flag for loop control
        inputSchemaReferenceId: awsp0
        outputSchemaReferenceId: ax0wd
        inputs:
        - name: more_pages
          operation:
            type: set
            value: false
    loop:
      type: while
      condition:
        $:and:
        - - $:ref: $variables.more_pages
          - $:eq: true
      delay: 0
      duration: 0
      limit: 50
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
  Get_Rule_Record:
    meta: {}
    title: Get Rule Record
    type: recordAction
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    on-success:
    - Declare_Loop_Variables: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    description: >
      Retrieves rule record from application using Rule_Tracking_ID filter
    inputs:
      applicationName: ""
      applicationId: aHIKL4OPed1qTNWcV
      filters:
      - fieldId: 6911e5d6cc49c1959ac2e747
        filterType: equals
        value: '{ $:ref: $inputs.Rule_Tracking_ID }'
      filterType: AND
      returnFields: []
      limit: 1
    recordActionType: search
meta:
  enabled: true
description: ""
namespace: $default
entrypoints:
- Define_Search_Parameters
pool: ""
timeout: 0
publish:
  Records_Matched:
    $:ref: $actions.Rule_Evaluator.result.published.Records_Matched
environment: {}
triggers: {}
inputSchemaReferenceId: 94773a5b-46af-4496-898f-fee1edc3013b
outputSchemaReferenceId: d0283938-5f48-4be6-9858-b446cde243ee
inputs:
  type: object
publishSchemaReferenceId: b761f9ba-dfe5-4d34-8e49-3b22a7160a72
